# Episode and Season Format

## What is fixed

> status: ratified (D-0043, D-0044)

Format serves exactly two masters: listener needs and the production process.
Fundability is explicitly irrelevant — this is an art project, and the first drop can
be 4 episodes or 40. Structurally fixed: each episode delivers a complete
Kishōtenketsu at the episode level (that is how listener trust is earned first), and
the narrator's cold open + outro bracket every episode ([[narrator-framing]]).

## The working frame

> status: ratified (D-0163)

Audio-native with narration, organized like a huge-scale anime: hundreds of episodes
at roughly thirty minutes each, not counting the theme song, closing song, and
credits. Exact per-season arithmetic stays the author's own design.

## Proposed numbers

> status: proposed

From the session's lit-agent exchange — engaged with, explicitly not fully agreed to
("not sure if 100% agree… but some of it seems plausible"; Q-0011): ~35-minute
episodes (3-minute cold open, ~25-minute present action, cliff-beat, ~3-minute
outro); 4-episode spoke-arcs shaped ki/shō/ten/ketsu across the four episodes;
12-episode seasons of three spokes; a first drop sized as one complete spoke. All of
it awaits ruling, and production reality may override.
